import re

def parse_nginx_log_line(line: str) -> dict:
    """
    Parse a standard nginx access log line into a dictionary.
    
    Expected format:
    <ip> - - [<date>] "<method> <url> <protocol>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<user_agent>"
    """
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'^(?P<ip>\S+)'
        r' - - '
        r'\[(?P<date>[^\]]+)\]'
        r' "(?P<method>\S+)'
        r' (?P<url>\S+)'
        r' (?P<protocol>[^"]+)"'
        r' (?P<status>\d+)'
        r' (?P<bytes>\d+)'
        r' "(?P<referer>[^"]*)"'
        r' "(?P<user_agent>[^"]*)"'
        r'$'
    )
    match = pattern.match(line)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not parse log line: {line}")
    return match.groupdict()
